# MemoryModule upstream notice

This lab vendors two source files from the public MemoryModule project for local learning experiments only:

- upstream: https://github.com/fancycode/MemoryModule
- files: `MemoryModule.c`, `MemoryModule.h`
- license header in source: Mozilla Public License Version 2.0

The current lab intentionally keeps the upstream implementation recognizable so the first experiment teaches the normal memory-DLL-loading flow. Later AV-facing experiments should not treat this public code as a final loader; it is reference material.
